CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2025 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2025 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,287 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 5 benchmark sites in 4 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: September 2025 to November 2025). These surveys captured 38 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 23 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 2,555 cards across 165 sites, with 9.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (254 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 409 transects across 114 sites (survey period: September 2025 to November 2025), detecting active burrows in 2% of transects (total: 12 active burrows).
